covered_invariants: A planned pass seals the ordered candidate operation vector, target/companion body digests, promotion current-claim precondition, cursor preconditions, and per-operation idempotency keys before mutation.
Changed target, companion, or current-claim preconditions produce a durable stale operation result and a non-committed terminal receipt without mutating the stale target.

An interruption after candidate mutation but before its operation frame replays the same PassID and exact operation list, records already_applied, and creates neither a duplicate claim nor a duplicate transition.
Terminal frames must exactly match the sealed intent and every recorded operation result; malformed result or post-terminal frames are rejected before a new pass begins.
